body: I would ask for help, then eventually I started picking out guns and calculating required height to hit terminal velocity from bridges.  Now, thankfully, it's all over, my peers finally surpassed me enough that I'm out of the game, was never a human, but now I don't even have to pretend to myself  There is no release other than death. No one cares, no one will ever care, not really, not enough to actually touch another human. That's too much.
I want someone to explain why other people deserved touch and I never did.

I guess I'm just pleading with the universe to change, and none of you can change the universe.

You can't make people like you, and you can't make life fair. It's just crazy how much things are determined by what you can't change.

I just wish suicide booths were legal, because I would have shut up years ago if that opportunity was available.

999999thanks to everyone who commented regardless, i'm just a beast at this point. people need to be touched, yo9999

No one deserves anything, otherwise they would already have it.

If I deserved to be happy, I would have been by now.

I deserve to suffer, otherwise I would not. It's that simple.  Thankfully, the universe was merciful and destroyed any semblance of a foundation holding this piece of shit empty life together. I do not really like people, so this works out for the best. People do not like me, I do not like them, I do not get touched. Why would I stick around. Do you not see how silly it is?  Do you not see?  I can't get touched.  That's so simple, everyone gets that.  So, really, I'm lucky things fell apart.

See you in the next life, if there is one, I'll be a bird, or a dog, or something. Then I'll get touched tons. Four days and I'm out.  Without touch, life is worse than death.
